references.text: Here it is confirmed that the Father has given the Son authority to judge, because He is the Son of Man, which expands on the statement in 5:22 that all judgment has been entrusted to the Son.
Jesus emphasizes that even though He judges, the judgment is righteous because it occurs in unity with the Father, reflecting the theme in 5:22 that the Father judges no one alone.
Jesus explains that He came into the world to judge, which specifies the universal judicial authority entrusted to Him in 5:22.
Here it is confirmed that it is Jesus' words that will judge those who reject Him on the last day, showing that the judgment authority given in 5:22 is exercised through His message.
In the prayer, Jesus confirms that the Father has given Him authority over all flesh to give eternal life, which is the same authority over judgment and life mentioned in 5:22.
Revelation shows the final judgment where the great white throne sits, representing the full execution of the judgment authority the Father has entrusted to the Son in 5:22.
